Justicia — Madrid, Spain

In detail

Justicia (which contains Chueca) has long-running, well-documented quality-of-life problems at Plaza Pedro Zerolo, where a homeless encampment has repeatedly occupied the children's play area (reported as far back as 2019, with a follow-up as recent as November 2025 describing a rat infestation), and the neighbourhood association has called the situation 'unsustainable.' This is a persistent social/quality-of-life concern rather than documented violent crime, robbery or drug-market activity. Sources checked: ElDiario.es Somos Chueca (Plaza Pedro Zerolo situation); Telemadrid, Nov 2025 (rat infestation); No specific robbery/violent-crime coverage found for Justicia/Chueca.
